requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Loaded current viewer HTML and followed its JavaScript/configuration.
Verified map host, dynamic ArcGIS path /arcgis2/rest/services/rGeoInfoMap/rgeo_highlight_d00/MapServer, and app web-service base /gih-ws2.

HK80 coordinates transformed from the exact WUP point; response returned ADDRESS 338 FANLING WAI and LOT FL 454 with native LOTID 1800068273. Address data was used only to document the response and was not retained as parcel evidence.
Verified current ArcGIS layer metadata; C1K_LOT_SDO is layer 107 with polygon geometry.
Bounded query where LOTID IN (1800068273), outFields=LOTID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson; returned one Polygon and only LOTID in properties.
Viewer-configured urgent-layer route was not needed for parcel evidence; no absence inference made.
